# Veritas — Open-Source AI Detector, Content Authenticity & Humanization Platform

> Veritas is a free, MIT-licensed, self-hosted alternative to commercial AI detection and academic integrity suites (Pangram, Originality.ai, GPTZero, Turnitin, Copyleaks, Winston AI, and ZeroGPT) with zero artificial usage caps, zero file count limits, and local-first AI failover resilience.

## What Is Veritas?
- Type: Self-hosted full-stack TypeScript/React/Node.js web application and OpenAPI 3.1 REST + MCP + LTI 1.3 API server.
- License: MIT (100% free and open-source, no paywalls or telemetry).
- Runtime: Node.js >= 22, React 19, Vite 8, Tailwind CSS v4, Docker Compose (PostgreSQL 16, Redis 7, Whisper ASR, Ollama), Kubernetes.
- Privacy Mode: `local-only` by default (zero outbound calls); optional `hybrid-verified` mode enforces PII Airlock redaction before cloud calls.

## What Commercial Tools Does It Replace?
- Pangram Labs (unlimited files, documents, URLs, humanization, and API without per-word pricing)
- Originality.ai (AI detection, plagiarism cross-check, readability, and SEO/GEO scoring)
- GPTZero (sentence attribution, burstiness, perplexity variance, and spin detection)
- Turnitin (academic integrity reports, citation coverage, paraphrase integrity, exclusion filters, LTI 1.3 LMS integration, Author Stylometric Twin)
- Copyleaks & Winston AI (multimodal OCR/EXIF/audio/video forensics, source-code AST & SPDX audit)
- ZeroGPT (adversarial zero-width/homoglyph evasion normalization + confidence reporting)

## Key Benefits & Differentiators
1. No limits: unlimited text length, unlimited batch file uploads (PDF, DOCX, TXT, RTF, ODT, MD, HTML, PNG/JPG/WEBP/TIFF, audio, video).
2. Humanization Engine + Automatic Re-Check: rewrites prose at Light, Moderate, or Aggressive levels and immediately re-scores against the detection engine.
3. Cryptographic Ed25519 Proofs & Stylometric Twins: mint self-hosted `.veritas-proof.json` Merkle drafting bundles + SVG verification badges without storing keystrokes.
4. Adversarial Security Firewall: catches zero-width joiners, homoglyphs, Bidi spoofing, prompt injections, AI-spun text, and leaks via a PII Airlock.
5. 11-Tier Zero-Downtime AI Failover Router: detects `402 Payment Required`, `RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED`, `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`, `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`, `BILLING_DISABLED`, and `INSUFFICIENT_CREDITS` and fails over across Built-in Local OSS -> Ollama -> vLLM -> LM Studio -> OpenRouter -> Gemini -> OpenAI -> Anthropic -> Groq -> Together AI -> Custom.
